provenance: written by bin/extract_patches.py from the slides the dataset manifest names, so every count and every patch in this document and in patches.csv is a function of those slides, of `config` below, and of nothing else. `patches_written` is the number of windows the filter accepted; `tissue_rejected` is the number it discarded on a single global mean-intensity cutoff (`extraction.tissue_gray_max`), which has no background rejection and whose sensitivity is unmeasured - this document records the cutoff that was applied, not a measurement of how well it separates tissue from background
